Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary below; attaching a starter SOW and a sample pilot invoice for numbers. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

High-level commercial components (private deployment):
1) Per-node license: recurring monthly fee per provisioned inference node (CPU/GPU mix).
2) Platform fee: monthly fixed fee for the private control plane + updates; charged per deployment, not per node.
3) SRE/ops retainer (optional): block of hours for on-call, upgrade assistance, and runbook support. Required only for SLA-backed production tiers.

Pilot-friendly options we can offer:
- 2-node pilot (90 days): 10% off per-node license for the pilot period.
- Platform fee: waive first month for pilots under 3 months; thereafter standard monthly platform fee applies.
- SRE retainer: 25% discount on the first 3 months if you commit to a 12-month support plan at go-live.

Support SLA: Standard private installs include 24-hour support response; production SLA (4-hour P1) requires an SRE retainer and an on-call rotation.

I've attached: MedForge_SOW_v1.pdf (starter SOW) and pilot-invoice.xlsx (example numbers).

Next step: if these options look reasonable, I'll draft a 90-day pilot SOW and loop legal for a short addendum.

Best,
